items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued November 14 at 10:42AM AKST by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
Strong northwesterly winds have developed across Shelikof Strait
and the waters around western Kodiak Island. These winds are
resuspending ash from the 1912 Katmai-Novarupta eruption, causing
haze and potentially trace amounts of ash accumulation. The
villages of Karluk and Larsen Bay are most likely to be impacted.

Those in sensitive groups or with respiratory ailments are
encouraged to avoid or reduce outdoor activity to avoid inhaling
the ash. The winds should weaken Saturday night.
